versions.changelog: MCP 1.7.0: signed intent (pass cart to bind the card to what it is for), signed execution receipt with per-field provenance, and a fixed 14-class failure_class enum replacing free-text failure reports.
Domain migration clawcard.store -> z-zero.xyz; new security section: rotate-on-connect Passport Keys (v1.5.0+), one key = one machine, pasted keys treated as burned
Initial release: gasless USDC on Base + JIT single-use virtual cards for agents, human-approval-gated
